from pathlib import Path
import os

def load_value():
    # Get the directory containing this file
    script_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    # Navigate to the parent directory (repository root) and then to inputs/value.txt
    file_path = script_dir.parent / "inputs" / "value.txt"
    return file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()

parsed_patch.notes: Changed path to be relative to script location using __file__ instead of relative to CWD.
